description: The line plot illustrates a comparison of Macro-F1 scores for two models, "MATTER (ours)" and "w/o material information," across a varying number of tokens during tokenization training. The x-axis is labeled "Number of tokens" and uses a linear scale with data spanning from 0.5 to 1.5. Numeric tick marks are spaced at regular intervals of 0.2, starting at 0.6 and ending at 1.4, with no units specified. The y-axis, labeled "Macro-F1 Score (%)", also employs a linear scale, featuring tick marks from 48 to 58 at intervals of 2. Both lines in the plot are solid, utilize circular markers at each data point, and are surrounded by a similarly colored translucent shaded region. The pink line, representing "MATTER (ours)", starts at roughly 55.1 at 0.5 tokens, dips slightly to 54.3 at 0.7 tokens, and rises to an initial peak of 57.0 at 0.8 tokens. It reaches its maximum value of approximately 57.9 at 1.0 tokens before entering a downward trend, punctuated by a minor rise to 53.5 at 1.4 tokens, and finishes at its lowest point of 50.9 at 1.5 tokens. The purple line, representing "w/o material information", begins at approximately 52.5 at 0.5 tokens and reaches an early peak of 54.1 at 0.7 tokens. It then exhibits a steady, gradual decline down to 51.7 at 1.3 tokens, briefly spikes to 53.3 at 1.4 tokens, and subsequently drops sharply to end at its minimum value of roughly 47.9 at 1.5 tokens.
